verdicts.reason: A reverses the headline order ('London' above 'FAMILY DAYS OUT IN'). Its 'Save your money' tagline sits right on top of the busy city photo and can't be read, the arrows are crammed together at the bottom edge over the image, and the translucent band has shrunk to a stray bar at the top. B keeps the reading order and leaves the tagline on lighter sky where it is mostly readable, but the translucent panel is split into two loose rectangles that look like glitches, and the six arrows are bunched into one row over the busy cityscape, so it is still clearly broken.
